text: West Plains native Stan Utley was inducted into the Missouri Golf Hall of Fame, announced Oct. 26, for his career as a professional golfer, instructor and junior golf advocate. A hole-in-one career.

Missouri Independent reporter Rudi Keller found campaign finance reports show Republicans well provisioned in tight legislative races, even as Missouri Democrats predict voter discontent will deliver them wins.
MoDOT picked specific rural interstate segments in Missouri where speed limits will rise from 70 to 75 mph under a new state law. Time to check the cruise control.

Missouri's State Board of Education is divided over the plan to give every public school and district an A-through-F grade, with St. Louis County board member Vincent Schoemehl Jr. questioning whether it would help struggling schools.
Missouri Interim Education Commissioner Stacey Preis resigned Oct. 20, effective immediately, as the State Board of Education searches for a permanent leader.
Patrick Mahomes threw for 272 yards and earned his 100th career win as the Chiefs beat the Chargers 22-6 to improve to 5-0. A hundred wins and counting.

No. 13 Missouri lost 31-3 at No. 9 Ole Miss, falling to 5-2 overall and 2-2 in SEC play, after settling for a field goal despite two first-half possessions inside the Ole Miss 10-yard line. Time to shake it off, Tigers.
